name: Firefont 04 mass driver cannon
description: The Firefont 04 mass driver cannon was a type of mass-driver cannon used by the AT-TE and the AT-AP. Manufactured by Gazac, the projectile cannon was turret-mounted to the walker's dorsal surface. The mass-driver cannon fired sonic charges, bunker busters, heat-seekers, as well as a variety of other projectile ammunition from its rotating turret.
